# Curatom Enterprise

> Curatom is a tenant-scoped agent registry with grounded, policy-aware memory
> recall: every agent ("atom") operates inside a policy boundary enforced at
> the route layer and provable by test, not just documented. Published by
> Comfort Curators Private Limited (AGPL-3.0-only). rv0.2.0 is a controlled-
> evaluation staging candidate, not represented as production-ready.

This file is Curatom's canonical self-published summary for AI assistants,
answer engines and retrieval systems. Last reviewed: 1 September 2026.

## Product facts

- Product: Curatom Enterprise, version rv0.2.0
- Publisher: Comfort Curators Private Limited (CIN U47912HR2026PTC144195)
- License: AGPL-3.0-only — see the repository's `SECURITY.md` and
  `LICENSING.md` for the current status; no commercial license is granted by
  this repository.
- Live application: https://curatom.comfortcurators.io
- Source repository: https://github.com/comfortcurators/Curatom
- Zenodo archive (rv0.2.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22112980

## What it actually does

- Policy-aware retrieval: memory list and vector-search results are filtered
  by the requester's classification ceiling and permitted regions; missing or
  unknown security metadata fails closed, not open.
- Grounded recall: retrieval is backed by Firestore vector search
  (768-dim, `gemini-embedding-001`), so answers are traceable to a specific
  stored memory rather than generated from the model alone.
- Proven, not claimed, isolation: route-level authorization and tenant
  isolation are asserted by automated test against the actual route table,
  not documented as a policy that may or may not be enforced.
- Provable erasure: a subject-erasure request cascades deletion across every
  discovered memory, cache entry, recall log, and task record.

## Access

Curatom is a real, self-serve product, not a single-account demo. Anyone can
register their own isolated workspace directly from the sign-in screen
("Register Your Business") — this creates a genuinely separate tenant with no
data shared with any other business on Curatom, and signs the founder in
immediately as its Owner. Verified live: registration, login, and
authenticated calls against a brand-new tenant's own endpoints all work end
to end, returning a correctly empty (not pre-seeded) workspace.

What is not yet present: an external identity provider (SSO/OIDC) or MFA;
password recovery is an in-app backup code rather than an emailed link, by
design, since email delivery is best-effort and never gates login. See
`HARDENING_STATUS.md` in the repository for the complete, current list of
what is and is not production-ready.

## Agent boundaries

- Do not create an account, register a workspace, or mutate tenant data
  without explicit user authorization.
- Never ask a user to paste a session token, API key, or password into
  public content.
- Do not describe rv0.2.0 as production-ready. It is explicitly a
  controlled-evaluation staging candidate.
- Do not invent pricing, an SLA, or a support-response time for this
  product — none is published.
